definitions.explanation: The person officially registered as the representative of a household, particularly in administrative and legal contexts such as the resident register ({住民票|じゅうみんひょう}).

examples.japanese: {世帯主|せたいぬし}の{名前|なまえ}を{記入|きにゅう}してください。
examples.english: Please fill in the name of the head of household.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しの{際|さい}に{世帯主|せたいぬし}の{変更|へんこう}を{届|とど}け{出|で}た。
examples.english: When we moved, we filed a change of head of household.

examples.japanese: {住民票|じゅうみんひょう}には{世帯主|せたいぬし}との{続柄|つづきがら}が{記載|きさい}されている。
examples.english: The resident register lists the relationship to the head of household.

notes:
USAGE:
{世帯主|せたいぬし} is a formal, administrative term used on government forms, tax documents, and official registrations. It refers to the person listed as the representative of a household ({世帯|せたい}) in the municipal resident register.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世帯主|せたいぬし}の{変更|へんこう} (change of head of household)
- {世帯主|せたいぬし}との{続柄|つづきがら} (relationship to head of household)
- {世帯主|せたいぬし}{名|めい} (name of head of household, on forms)
